title: SatCompute TransferTrace 0.1
description: Closed-world direct-transfer workload for one SatCompute scenario.

schema_version.description: TransferTrace contract version; version 0.1 is required by this schema.

transfers.description: Non-empty direct-transfer set; array order has no semantic effect.

transfer.description: One UDP payload transfer between stable external satellite IDs.

transfer_id.description: Positive unique uint64 ID used for canonical execution order.

source_node_id.description: Stable external uint32 satellite ID of the UDP sender.

destination_node_id.description: Receiver's external uint32 satellite ID; it must differ from the source.

size_bytes.description: Positive application bytes excluding UDP, IPv4, and link headers.

arrival_time_ns.description: Non-negative integer-ns start offset that precedes simulation stop.
